description: This file defines the class EmbeddedURLForDailymotion which extends an abstract class for handling video URLs, specifically for Dailymotion embedded URLs. It includes regex patterns for matching Dailymotion URLs and methods to extract or validate embedded URLs.

classes.name: EmbeddedURLForDailymotion
classes.description: A class handling validation and retrieval of embedded Dailymotion video URLs, extending AbstractBuzzVideoURL.

methods.name: getEmbeddedURL
methods.description: Returns the embedded Dailymotion URL if the provided URL matches the expected pattern, otherwise throws an exception.
